name: 1X NEO
description: Home humanoid from 1X Technologies (backed by OpenAI), built with a soft, tendon-driven body designed to operate safely around people and learn household chores through 1X's Redwood AI model.
sourcing: Specs sourced from 1X Technologies' official NEO page and cross-checked against TechCrunch/Yahoo News coverage of the December 2025 pricing announcement, as of September 2026. robotindex does not sell this product — pricing and availability are per 1X's own preorder terms and may change.

pricing.summary: **$20,000**, secured via a $200 refundable preorder deposit. US shipments are targeted for 2026, with international rollout not planned until 2027, so it isn't yet available to buy outright.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Built around **tendon-driven actuators** (not rigid gearboxes) for high backdrivability (~95%) and quiet operation. Perception uses **dual 8.85MP 90Hz stereo fisheye cameras**, 4 beamforming microphones, and body-wide IMUs. The soft 3D-lattice polymer shell under a washable nylon suit is designed to keep head injury criterion (HIC) under 250 and avoid joint pinch points. Hands are IP68; body IP44.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: NEO uses tendon-driven actuators rather than the rigid gearboxes common in competing humanoids, tied to a measurable ~22 dB operating noise level and ~95% backdrivability. That's a genuine mechanical differentiator reflected in the spec sheet itself, not just marketing prose.

firmwareCommunity.note: 1X's in-house vision-language-action model for learning household tasks. Closed platform — no public SDK or firmware repo yet. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
